decisionRationale: V7 has active route usage via DocudentV7Page.tsx with full UI wiring through useV7Pipeline hook
V7 has dedicated E2E test coverage: gate10-runMultiFromDictation-e2e.test.ts, contract-drift, reality-integration, no-logic tests
V7 is designed for extensibility with clean separation: multitreatment/, pipeline/, components/, hooks/ structure
V7 reuses V6 extraction services internally (extractionService.ts) - no duplication, proper layering

V6.role: Logic donor - extraction and questions services consumed by V7
V6.note: V6 services are imported by V7 pipeline - not standalone

V5.role: Historical reference only - billing logic migrated to core/billing/
V5.note: No active development; critical logic extracted to knowledgeBase

rulesGoingForward: All new UI features go to V7 (pages, components, hooks)
Billing logic must live in core/billing/knowledgeBase/logic/
No new features in V5 - treat as read-only archive
V6 services may be modified only to support V7 pipeline needs
New tests should use V7 entry points (runMultiFromDictation, generiereHKP*)
